svg.title: The lattice of transmon_surface17
svg.desc: The 17 qudits of transmon_surface17 on a square lattice. The 9 data qudits D1 to D9, indices 0 to 8, fill a grid row by row. Each of the 8 auxiliary qudits sits between the data qudits it couples to: X1 (index 9) couples to D2, D3; X2 (index 10) couples to D1, D2, D4, D5; X3 (index 11) couples to D5, D6, D8, D9; X4 (index 12) couples to D7, D8; Z1 (index 13) couples to D1, D4; Z2 (index 14) couples to D4, D5, D7, D8; Z3 (index 15) couples to D2, D3, D5, D6; Z4 (index 16) couples to D6, D9.
